buy.note: The price follows the BTC rate and is fixed at the moment of purchase. Yield is an estimate based on the series APY and the current rate.

apy.title: Annual yield
apy.content: This node's target yield is {{apy}} per year in BTC equivalent. Earnings accrue while the node is running.

price.title: Dynamic price
price.content: The price equals {{nominal}} at the current BTC/USDT rate, so it changes with the market.

ref.title: Partner reward
ref.content: You receive {{ref}} per year from the nominal of this node owned by your first-line partners, while your own node is running.
